result.summary: The page is largely well-designed with a clear hierarchy, consistent spacing, and readable typography. The horizontally scrollable category chips and restaurant carousel (with the last item partially clipped at the right edge) and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport are intentional features and not defects. One minor visual concern remains: the white delivery-time badges and white discount badge sit on top of light/illustrated backgrounds in a couple of cards, slightly reducing legibility, but overall no broken layout was found.

issues.description: The white '15–25 min' badge on the Green Bowl Poké card sits over a very light grey/white illustrated background, giving the badge low separation from its surroundings compared to the same badge on darker cards.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or a thin border to the time badges so they remain clearly distinguishable on both light and dark card backgrounds.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right relies on a small red dot to indicate unread notifications, which may be hard to notice and is not conveyed to screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label/badge count (e.g., aria-label='Notifications, 1 unread') and consider a slightly larger or higher-contrast indicator.
